issue.title: Memory panel badges and relation chips are unreadable in the light theme: fixed #1a1a1a text on the dark navy light-theme accent
issue.description: In the light theme the Memory panel card's badge row (REFERENCE · read on demand, CORE · always loaded, MANAGED · RENDERED FROM MEMORY, GENERATED, ...) and the numbered PARENT/CHILDREN relation chips render near-black text on a dark navy background, so the labels are effectively invisible. Root cause: append_badge() in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/memory_panel_rendering.py styles every badge 'bold #1a1a1a on {accent}' with a fixed _BADGE_FOREGROUND = '#1a1a1a', while memory_card_accent(app.current_theme) returns a dark accent for textual-light; the numbered chip rows (build_numbered_chip_rows) use the same accent background. Fix: derive the badge foreground from the accent's luminance (or pick a theme-aware contrast color), then refresh the light-theme goldens with just fix-tui-screenshots and inspect them.

task_type_fields.impact: Light-theme users cannot read note type, generated/shadow/orphan/invalid warnings, or relation chip labels on the Memory card.
task_type_fields.repro: just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_memory_panel.py, then open tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/memory_panel_populated_light_120x40.png (also memory_pane_instructions_group_light_120x40.png): the REFERENCE badge and the .1/.2 relation chips are dark text on dark navy.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the sase-1ev land agent while inspecting memory-panel PNG goldens; it predates sase-1ev (the sase-1dr goldens committed in f28d171585 already show it), so it is not epic work.
